recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes should preserve the clarification on MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction while avoiding duplication of that guidance on unrelated packaging or dose-aid elements.
issue_request: FHIR-8021 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Pharmacy clarification asking to differentiate MedicationDispense.dosageInstructions from prescription dosage instructions by noting that the pharmacist reviews the prescription/order before dispense and updates MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction based on the actual product dispensed.
initial_application: Commit 1cb9689e725c06210bbeaa920648410591a426d4 explicitly named gForge change request 8021 and added the pharmacist-review wording to the MedicationDispense dosageInstruction spreadsheet source. Commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 later carried that wording into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini records MedicationPrescription as having become MedicationRequest. Later FHIR-52892 added MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid and initially copied the neighboring dosageInstruction comment there, but the already-published FHIR-8502 reconciliation on the combined branch removed that copied comment and updated the remaining MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction wording for current R6 dosage terms.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the latest combined branch already has the correct source state: the FHIR-8021 clarification remains on MedicationDispense.dosageInstruction, refers to MedicationRequest, and is not duplicated onto MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid.

related_jiras.note: Already-published combined-branch reconciliation updated current R6 MedicationDispense dosageInstruction wording and removed the copied dosageInstruction comment from doseAdministrationAid.
Added MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid and explains how the copied comment appeared; it is already represented on the combined branch and was not decided again.
Added the analogous MedicationRequest doseAdministrationAid pattern without a dosageInstruction/pharmacist-review comment.
